messages:
Ava: Morning — found a tiny laminated treaty under the snack jar labeled "Council of the Jar". Anyone know who started this?
Sam: ahaha no idea. there's also a wax seal? :o
Priya: i put that there? joking. maybe Ken's new office art project.
Ken: guilty-ish. I made a mock-constitution. Clause 1: All cookies are community property unless labeled.
Diana: Clause 2: anyone who microwaves fish must compensate with a donut.
Ava: who signed it?
Ken: signatures: Stan (Monstera), Spike (cactus), The Microwave (anonymous), + random doodles.
Zara: OpsBot: Facilities reminder: do not affix items to appliances or plants. Treat seal as decorative only.
OpsBot: OpsBot: Automated: Lost & Found box located near reception. If you found the wax seal, drop it there.
Priya: also there's a tiny oath we have to recite to join. I propose "for crumbs and camaraderie".
Sam: We need membership cards. Design idea: velvet sticker with crumb emblem.
Diana: I can make a tiny stamp. Who's the registrar?
Ava: @Priya you volunteered last week for snack logistics? think you want registrar?
Priya: sure, registrar of crumbs. badge title: Grand Crumbkeeper.
Ken: ceremony at 3pm. mandatory cheering optional. :confetti_ball:
Zara: calendar invite sent (3–3:10) — meeting room: Courtyard bench. Bring symbolic cookie.
Sam: i'll bring a biscotti for authentication.
Ava: ok council meeting adjourned. Long live the Jar. :cookie:
